findings.title: twelve misidentified physiological references
a controlled study is created from an uncontrolled pilot
eddii's outcome evidence is materially understated
I Got This has the wrong disease and provenance
mixed-diabetes findings are labelled direct T1D evidence
non-release is converted into disappearance
sustainability hypotheses become established causal explanations
historical search reproducibility is overstated
study extraction is incomplete despite a complete-looking schema
Qare and Qure's paired-caregiver interpretation is unverified
prescriptive learning claims exceed their cited support
the five-to-eight-user heuristic needs qualification
field-wide absence claims lack reproducible bounds
platform and availability representations disagree
bibliographic metadata needs a second pass beyond wrong identifiers
quantitative physiology is not consistently anchored to context
endpoint labels obscure what was measured
numerical accuracy is not the same as methodological credibility
useful comparator literature is omitted or disconnected
“neutral” comparison still contains unlabelled preferences
source acquisition was too narrowly governed and incompletely tracked
governance contradicts the current licensing documents
living-update provenance is insufficiently granular
correction propagation and release checks are inadequate

note: Finding statuses refer to reviewed scientific content, not the newly delivered audit tooling.
